units.title: Unit 1: Nuancing Thoughts & Expressing Complex Opinions

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous vs Simple & Present Deduction
grammar: Present Perfect Continuous for ongoing actions and duration up to now
Present Perfect Simple for completed achievements and life results
Modals of deduction (must, can't, might, could) for present speculation
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-B1-001"
pronunciation: [{"point":"Connected speech & weak forms","explain":"Mastering weak forms of auxiliary verbs (have/has/been) in natural continuous speech.","examples":[{"pattern":"have been working","ipa":"/həv bɪn ˈwɜː.kɪŋ/","word":"been"}],"visual":"🎵"}]
cando: "Can express necessity, nuanced desires, and speculate on present situations using modals of deduction"

lessons.title: Expressing Cause, Consequence & Polite Disagreement
grammar: Connectors of cause and consequence (due to, owing to, as a result, consequently)
Polite disagreement structures (I see your point, however / I agree up to a point, but)
Second and Third Conditionals for hypothetical scenarios
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-B1-002"
cando: "Can structure simple logical arguments and express polite disagreement in discussions"
